directPaymentDiscovery.scope: Official Stadtwerke Kulmbach public-station listing plus station-level Mobilithek/Eco-Movement discovery

stationLevelDiscovery.note: Mobilithek-derived station surfaces report 0.40 EUR/kWh on these EVSEs, but some records identify energielösung GmbH as technical operator while the Stadtwerke site presents the public locations. Ownership/price authority is therefore not generalized to the full Stadtwerke Kulmbach network.

reason: The official operator site confirms public charging locations but publishes no current direct-payment tariff. Station-level open-data discovery is useful evidence for specific EVSEs but is not sufficient to establish a network-wide Stadtwerke Kulmbach tariff or resolve the technical-operator relationship without an authoritative checkout/source binding.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Obtain an official QR/direct-payment checkout for a Stadtwerke Kulmbach EVSE, or an AFIR/Mobilithek record that includes authoritative tariff and operator-role fields sufficient to bind price to each EVSE without network extrapolation.
